claim.claim-text: 1. A sound output control system, comprising:

determine whether the voice recognition device (20, 21, 22) and the electronic device (10, 30, 40, 50) are located in the same region based on the identification information received from the server (100) and the identification information of the electronic device (10, 30, 40, 50), and based on the voice recognition device and the electronic device being located in the same region, change the sound being output from the electronic device.

2. The sound output control system of claim 1, wherein the electronic device (10, 30, 40, 50) is configured to determine that the voice recognition device and the electronic device are located in the same region based on the identification information of the electronic device being included in the identification information received from the server.

3. The sound output control system of claim 1 or 2, wherein the electronic device is configured to reduce the volume of the sound being output to a predetermined volume based on the voice recognition device and the electronic device being located in the same region.

4. The sound output control system of claim 1 or 2, wherein the electronic device is configured to be turned off based on the voice recognition device and the electronic device being located in the same region.

5. The sound output control system of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the electronic device is configured to keep outputting the sound based on the identification information received from the server not including the identification information of the electronic device.

6. A method of controlling a system including a server (100), a plurality of electronic devices (10, 30, 40, 50) configured to output sound, and a voice recognition device (20, 21, 22), the method comprising:

receiving, at the server (100), identification information of the voice recognition device (20, 21, 22) and at least one electronic device (10, 30, 40, 50) located in a region around the voice recognition device (20, 21, 22), and the server transmitting the identification information to the plurality of electronic devices (10, 30, 40, 50); the method further comprising: based on receiving information from the server (100) that a voice command is received from a user through the voice recognition device (20, 21, 22):

determining, at each of the electronic devices, whether the voice recognition device (20, 21, 22) and the electronic device (10, 30, 40, 50) are located in the same region, based on the identification information received from the server and identification information of the electronic device; and each electronic device changing the sound being output by the electronic device, based on the voice recognition device and the electronic device being located in the same region.

7. The method of claim 6, wherein determining that the voice recognition device and the electronic device are located in the same region is based on the identification information of the electronic device being included in the identification information received from the server.

8. The method of claim 6 or 7, wherein changing the sound comprises reducing the volume of the sound being output to a predetermined volume based on the voice recognition device and the electronic device being located in the same region.
9. The method of claim 6 or 7, wherein changing the sound comprises turning off the electronic device based on the voice recognition device and the electronic device being located in the same region.

10. The method of any one of claims 6 to 9, further comprising: the electronic device continuing to output the sound based on the identification information received from the server not including the identification information of the electronic device.
